# RigidBody

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** both · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/rigid_body.h`](../../../src/logic/components/rigid_body.h)

## Summary

A Jolt body (box, sphere or capsule; static, dynamic or kinematic) attached to the entity's Transform.

## Description

Request for a Jolt body: RigidBodySys creates it on its first tick after the component appears (needs a Transform) and stores the BodyID in `body`; destroying the entity or removing the component destroys the body (on_destroy hook). Dynamic bodies are simulated and their Transform written back (interpolated through PhysicsPose); kinematic ones follow their Transform; static ones never move. Units are world units (metres in the agent worlds), kg. Created from scene JSON (`RigidBody` key), by BoxDropSys::init and by host view systems (BoxRing, BoxThrower, VRControl hands). The sphere agent's SphereControl / SphereTask / SphereObserve read `body` and `half_extent`.

## Scene JSON

"RigidBody": { "motion": "static|dynamic|kinematic", "shape": "box|sphere|capsule", "half_extent", "offset", "friction", "restitution", "angular_damping", "mass", "initial_velocity", "initial_angular_velocity" } (all optional; unknown keys and enum values rejected)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `motion` | `RigidBody::Motion (Static, Dynamic, Kinematic)` | Motion::Dynamic | simulation mode |
| `shape` | `RigidBody::Shape (Box, Sphere, Capsule)` | Shape::Box | collision shape |
| `half_extent` | `glm::vec3` | (0.5, 0.5, 0.5) | world units, scale included; sphere radius = x; capsule radius = x, cylinder half-height = y (local Y) |
| `offset` | `glm::vec3` | (0, 0, 0) | shape centre relative to the Transform position, local space |
| `friction` | `float` | 0.6 | Jolt friction |
| `restitution` | `float` | 0.1 | Jolt restitution |
| `angular_damping` | `float` | 0.05 | Jolt's default |
| `mass` | `float` | 0 | kg, inertia scaled to it; 0 = Jolt's density of 1000 kg/m^3 |
| `initial_velocity` | `glm::vec3` | (0, 0, 0) | m/s at body creation |
| `initial_angular_velocity` | `glm::vec3` | (0, 0, 0) | rad/s at body creation |
| `body` | `uint32_t` | 0xffffffff | JPH::BodyID index+sequence, assigned by RigidBodySys; created() is body != 0xffffffff |
